claim: For MySQL and MariaDB workloads that use temporary objects, RDS Optimized Reads places the temporary objects on NVMe-based instance storage instead of the EBS volume, speeding up complex query processing by up to 2X.

evidence.quote: Workloads that use temporary objects in MySQL and MariaDB for query processing benefit from Amazon RDS Optimized Reads. Optimized Reads place temporary objects on the database instance's NVMe-based instance storage, instead of the Amazon Elastic Block Store volume. This helps to speed up complex query processing by up to 2X.
